reels.title: CineRecon: Benchmarking Frontier Models for Agentic Cinematic Reconstruction

editorial_notes.reasoning: High audience velocity multiplier (1.25x) and fits the developer_perks category; it bridges the gap between AI research and creative film production, which is highly visual.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could turn any home movie into a fully editable 3D world?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A film editor's 'magic magnifying glass' that lets you step inside the frame and rearrange the furniture in 3D space.
